answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in an agent mesh tracking yarrow flora, sparrow flocks, and ferrous slag, nodes mandate proof-of-space validation. Each agent commits cryptographic plot data to physical disk and answers random challenge audits with rapid sector-lookup proofs. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of dedicating discrete, uncompressed storage hardware per identity. However, this scheme favors well-funded server farms and marginalizes lightweight edge agents.
